text:
elaine: Quick ask — we need a tight play for Tue's webinar. One-pager + 2 slides that compare Redwood inference vs managed cloud endpoints and developer-facing LLM APIs. Focus: deployment options, predictable latency, and cost levers. Can someone own messaging + battlecard snippets?
mike: I can draft the battle claims. Need concrete benchmark bullets (p95, cost tokens) and a short callout for fallbacks.
tara: +1. Let's avoid broad 'we're faster' claims — frame as 'predictable latency under load' and 'cost controls via batching + cache'. Customers buy predictability. :point_up: 
sam: I can build the slide deck. Mike, if you drop the bullets I’ll mock slides and push to the deck. Prefer a single visual comparing latency distribution and unit cost.
nana: (typo) ana: Also add a console screenshot idea — token-level cost breakdown + per-route traces. Helps field teams show evidence in demos.
mike: Draft benchmark snippet below — please sanity-check before I add to the battlecard:
```
Benchmark (internal harness, 8xA100 equiv):
- Redwood (default): p50 40ms, p95 120ms, tokens/second 220
- CloudX managed endpoint: p50 60ms, p95 320ms, tokens/second 180
- Generic LLM API: p50 70ms, p95 400ms, tokens/second 150
Cost per 1M tokens (effective, w/ batching + cache):
- Redwood: $85 
- CloudX: $140 
- Generic LLM API: $165
Notes: numbers depend on model/seq len; highlight regression ranges in footnotes.
```
elaine: Good start. Add brief methodology line: "uniform request mix, 1k concurrent connections, 512 seq avg". Keep claims explicit: "predictable p95 under concurrent load" and "per-token unit cost after batching+cache".
tara: For sales snippets we need 3 short rebut lines (20 words max) vs each competitor: CloudX, LLM API, InfraVendor. I'll write these and post later. :memo: 
sam: Uploaded slide mock to drive: https://docs.google.com/d/drive-mock/redwood/webinar-deck (will replace with real link). I'll do two options: data-first slide and narrative-first slide. 
deploy-bot: PR created: docs/marketing/battlecards/field-armory-321 — PR #572 (assignee: mike).
nana: ana: On compliance angle: add a one-line note: "Private deploy (VPC/on-prem) + KMS/HSM options for regulated PII workloads". Sales want this as a separate bullet.
mike: I'll fold ana's compliance line into the one-pager and shorten the benchmark note. Also add a small FAQ: "What if customer cares about raw model access?" -> "We support model pinning and variant routing; we optimize serving economics without vendor lock."
elaine: Timeline: Mike finalizes copy by EOD Friday, Sam finishes slides by Monday, Tara publishes 3 rebut lines by Friday. We'll sync Friday 10am if needed. Thanks y'all. :raised_hands:
